Stripped PE32 i386 fixture for kuna_calleestackargs (tests/stages/kuna-calleeargs.xml).

byval_pe_i386.cpp and byval_pe_i386_impl.cpp are compiled by Visual C++ 2005 SP1
(`cl /O2 /c`, outputs renamed byval_pe_i386_c.obj and byval_pe_i386_impl.obj).
`draw` (0x401000) calls paint(a, b, 3), then passes a 32-byte Rect by value to
fill, which VC8 builds with `sub esp,0x20; mov edi,esp; rep movsd`.

Build:
  lld-link /nologo /entry:start /subsystem:console /nodefaultlib /base:0x400000 \
    /fixed /safeseh:no /opt:noref /Brepro /out:byval_pe_i386.exe \
    byval_pe_i386_c.obj byval_pe_i386_impl.obj
